**Test build for Nexo 1.2**: fixes **Nintendo 64** games crashing in the Emulator. Everyone else stays on v1.1.0.

> **Hosts:** no server update needed; servers on test.3 work with this build.

## Fixes

- **Nintendo 64:** games no longer freeze once there's a lot on screen (Mario Kart 64 froze when a race was
  about to start). The game's 3D graphics were corrupting the emulator's memory until it crashed.
- **Crashes show up:** if a game's emulator ever crashes, the host now sees "The game crashed and stopped"
  instead of a frozen picture. Loading the game again gets you playing.

## What to test

- **Nintendo 64:** play past the start of a race or level. Do the 3D graphics look right, and is it full
  speed? Short stutters right after the game starts are expected. Tell us which games break.
- **PlayStation** and **Mega Drive**, as in test.3.

## Leaving test builds

Already on a test build? Nothing to do: Nexo updates itself. To go back to the regular releases:
**Settings → App → Updates → Leave test builds**, then restart Nexo.
